newsitem.title: USA: Aon completes catastrophe equity put.
newsitem.headline: Aon completes catastrophe equity put.

text.p: Aon Group Inc, acting with the capital markets subsidiaries of Aon Corp, said Monday that Horace Mann Educators Corp entered into a multi-year $100 million catastrophe equity put (CatEPUT) option program structured by Aon.

Aon Re Inc, Horace Mann's reinsurance broker, worked with Aon subsidiaries to develop the program, which allows Horace Mann to replace equity in the event of a mega-catastrophe or a series of large catastrophes that produce losses in excess of its strong traditional reinsurance protection.
Aon is an insurance services holding company. Horace Mann sells retirement annunities and car, home and life insurance to teachers.
